newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes weaker, but bounces off lows.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes weaker, but bounces off lows.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed weaker on Friday but front month February clambered off the lows in late trade.
February last traded $1.50 down at $190.25 a tonne, up from the session low of $186.00.
"It's towards the top of the day's range, but today's range is at the bottom of yesterday's range - that's not what I call positive," one broker said.
The day's action was seen as further progress on the downward path established by NYMEX heating oil futures, albeit one of consolidation of Thursday's more definite move lower.
Volumes were seen similarly slimmer than Thursday, set against the background of poor physical demand from the German market.
Brent crude futures staged a similar muted late recovery as front month March reached $21.61 a barrel by 1803 GMT, eight cents down but off the $21.45 session low.
